property_summary: For any caller sending exactly 10 ether at a strictly increasing timestamp, the reference contract only drains its entire balance to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0 (so address(c).balance == 0 after the call iff block.number % 15 == 0); the mutant inverts that condition and will sometimes drain at block numbers where block.number % 15 != 0, violating this rule.
change_summary: Invert the block condition so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0, changing when balance is sent and observable behavior.
